@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: My father is a person worth trusting because he always f______ls his promises.
= fulfills
~詞義 fulfill（v.）實現
~原文 My father is a person worth trusting because he always fulfills his promises.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The singer's s______e hairstyle made her instantly recognizable, even in crowded public places.
= signature
~詞義 signature（adj.）獨樹一格的
~原文 The singer's signature hairstyle made her instantly recognizable, even in crowded public places.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: We've had c______s rain since this morning, so we canceled our picnic and stayed home watching TV instead.
= continuous
~詞義 continuous（adj.）連續的
~原文 We've had continuous rain since this morning, so we canceled our picnic and stayed home watching TV instead.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The w______s statement provides an accurate account of exactly how the accident happened.
= witness
~詞義 witness（n.）目擊證人
~原文 The witness statement provides an accurate account of exactly how the accident happened.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Lisa has no t______e for cold weather, so she dreams of moving to Singapore.
= tolerance
~詞義 tolerance（n.）忍受力
~原文 Lisa has no tolerance for cold weather, so she dreams of moving to Singapore.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The firefighters are well trained to deal with ______ situations like this, so there is no need to worry about them.
A: ashamed
B: voluntary
C: urgent
D: intense
= C
~詞義 urgent（adj.）緊急的
~原文 The firefighters are well trained to deal with urgent situations like this, so there is no need to worry about them.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ way of solving this problem has been replaced with a more effective solution.
A: incredible
B: conventional
C: triumphant
D: shameful
= B
~詞義 conventional（adj.）傳統的
~原文 The conventional way of solving this problem has been replaced with a more effective solution.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Driving a car without ______ your seatbelt is dangerous.
A: interacting
B: retreating
C: tumbling
D: fastening
= D
~詞義 fasten（v.）繫緊
~原文 Driving a car without fastening your seatbelt is dangerous.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The choir produced a(n) ______ blend of voices, filling the auditorium with warm, balanced sounds.
A: intensive
B: interactive
C: prominent
D: harmonious
= D
~詞義 harmonious（adj.）和諧的
~原文 The choir produced a(n) harmonious blend of voices, filling the auditorium with warm, balanced sounds.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Tony put forward a(n) ______, but his suggestion to reform the organization was rejected.
A: triumph
B: intensity
C: proposal
D: remedy
= C
~詞義 proposal（n.）提案
~原文 Tony put forward a(n) proposal, but his suggestion to reform the organization was rejected.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: intense
B: prominence
C: cooperative
D: mild
E: urged
F: annoyed

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The scientist's research achieved international ______ because her discoveries challenged traditional theories.
= B
~詞義 prominence（n.）突出;顯著;引人注目
~原文 The scientist's research achieved international prominence because her discoveries challenged traditional theories.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The lawyer ______ his clients to take further legal action.
= E
~詞義 urge（v.）敦促;力勸
~原文 The lawyer urged his clients to take further legal action.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Today is a pleasant, ______ spring day, so we should go for a stroll outdoors.
= D
~詞義 mild（adj.）溫和的
~原文 Today is a pleasant, mild spring day, so we should go for a stroll outdoors.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Last night, there was a mosquito in my room, and it ______ me greatly.
= F
~詞義 annoy（v.）煩擾
~原文 Last night, there was a mosquito in my room, and it annoyed me greatly.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The pain was so ______ that it left the poor patient unable to sit still.
= A
~詞義 intense（adj.）強烈的
~原文 The pain was so intense that it left the poor patient unable to sit still.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: overcome
B: exception
C: categorizes
D: privilege
E: differ
F: devices

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The store sells all kinds of electronic ______, such as computers, digital cameras, and televisions.
= F
~詞義 device（n.）設備
~原文 The store sells all kinds of electronic devices, such as computers, digital cameras, and televisions.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Though the problem seems complicated, we must have faith that we'll be able to ______ it.
= A
~詞義 overcome（v.）克服
~原文 Though the problem seems complicated, we must have faith that we'll be able to overcome it.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Many people believe that access to education should not be a(n) ______ but a right for all.
= D
~詞義 privilege（n.）特權
~原文 Many people believe that access to education should not be a(n) privilege but a right for all.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Shopping habits of men and women ______ greatly.
= E
~詞義 differ（v.）不同
~原文 Shopping habits of men and women differ greatly.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The teacher often ______ assignments by difficulty to help her students track their progress and manage their work.
= C
~詞義 categorize（v.）分類
~原文 The teacher often categorizes assignments by difficulty to help her students track their progress and manage their work.
